name: Quantum Internet Alliance (QIA)
description: The Quantum Internet Alliance is a consortium of 40 European academic, industrial, and research organisations across nine countries, led by QuTech (TU Delft and TNO). Funded under the EU Quantum Flagship, QIA is building the first full-stack prototype quantum internet network connecting distant cities via entanglement-based quantum communication and quantum repeaters.

news.title: Round Three of The Quantum Internet Application Challenge Kicks Off
news.excerpt: QIA has opened registration for the 2025 Quantum Internet Application Challenge, inviting innovators to design applications for quantum internet. Submissions due December 21, 2025. Top prize: research visit or internship worth up to €5,000 at QIA partner institutions.

news.title: QIA at Quantum Meets '26: Showcasing Europe's Path from Quantum Internet Research to Impact
news.excerpt: The Quantum Internet Alliance (QIA) was pleased to participate in Quantum Meets '26, bringing together researchers, startups, industry leaders, investors, and policymakers from across the quantum technology ecosystem.

news.title: GÉANT and Quantum Internet Alliance sign MoU to advance European cross-border quantum networking
news.excerpt: GÉANT and QIA signed a Memorandum of Understanding on September 8, 2026, to collaborate on European quantum networking infrastructure and standards, targeting the transition of laboratory-scale quantum communication prototypes into operational cross-border field trials.
